reviews.classification: cumulative north-star opening3280 lines; actual status/creation corrections and locally scoped observation, identity, shared-data and variant proposals
reviews.disposition:
Continuation of B444–B445: freshly read original lines1,681–3,280 in eight contiguous200-line ranges. Together with the recorded, unchanged earlier prefix, cumulative coverage is1–3,280. The rest3,281–7,761 and appended notices remain open. The superpower digest begun in the prior range is now covered through its ending; this range then covers research, followers/factions, ancient plans, work, romance, far-field/trope palettes, scale, identity modes, bodies/crafting, creation/entry/observation, system meetings, tech/walls/lore, integration/system scope and the opening variant-world plan. It ends before later variant/cheat revisions and does not claim them read.

**Later corrections within this range matter.** The next-absorption section explicitly marks the earlier “not owned” list stale. Its installed/extracted/status/dispatch assertions are still October8 evidence, not today's acquisition gaps or live processes. The creation section corrects the prior race-multiplier claim: definitions/tooltips existed while actual bonuses were off. No current source audit or bonus activation follows. Q1 is corrected from every route available to source-grounded local entries, and Q2–Q5 already received “depends on the world/starting point/means” answers. Do not ask those questions again as unsettled either/or choices. Quick/curated/full creation, all14 layers, fixed gene pairs, paid rerolls, birth-fixed difficulty and a screen for every world remain proposals; [current entry rules](WORLD_ENTRY_RULES.md) and [starts palette](STARTS_ENDINGS_AND_RANDOMNESS_PALETTE.md) govern selected work. A trait can have mechanical consequences where relevant without every field requiring all seven depth-checklist systems at once.

**Mechanisms qualify universal-sounding models.** Not every growth method is research, not every power needs two bars/four gates, and not every failed attempt teaches or every disassembly yields a recipe. Counterexamples may arise from actual faculty, direct grant, sample quality, information loss or incompatible laws. Stated quantities and genuine repeat production/practice follow their actual owners. Proposed once-in-a-life masterpieces, leadership caps/inevitable disloyalty, equal-body tradeoffs, romance ladders, forced stereotype blind spots and deed-gated crossings/deaths are local palette options. Keep unpaid/generous help, strong bodies, unequal starts, mundane competent lives, optional romance and actual player goals available. The authoring policy excluding real-world ethnicity from stats remains distinct from world/species/body differences and fictional unequal societies. Biological parentage, adoption, host body, soul memories and social/legal ties must not collapse into one inherited record.

**Observation and identity.** Useful distinctions include objective subject, dated claim, observer method, stale report, source/channel and actual consequence. A reading can be partial, false or accurate; it need not always be an opposed rank contest, costly, traceable or dangerous. Gods, wills, familiar observers and systems are not automatically omniscient, nor automatically wrong. Known observers' readings are shown only when the player has a route to know them. Earlier unreliable-own-system examples do not revoke own-status direction in [the rules index](RULES_INDEX.md). Player knowledge does not produce an automatic detectable future-knowledge trace without a real channel. The document itself broadens A/B/C identity into A–G per-life modes; a soul mode or third-person historical bio is not selected for all lives. Amnesia does not necessarily erase two entire knowledge stores, and log voice or a scientist/doctor/soldier label does not impose a fixed personality on the player. Current [presentation owner](PRESENTATION_AND_FOURTH_WALL.md) keeps narrator/UI and character voice distinct.

**Local laws, real counters and useful content.** The superpower/Worm, source-book and MTL summaries are dated dossier claims, not a new primary-source read or universal genre rules. There is no automatic hostile notice, guaranteed escalating fee, mandatory learning route, trauma origin, revocable loyalty or forced counter because a power becomes strong. World stance, hub roles, legal authority and actor motives need actual owners and means. Ancient plans and corrupt inheritances can be genuine temptations without turning every gift into a trap; work, friendship, craft, family and small details remain useful in their own right. A bespoke scene or biography detail need not change every meter. Discovery can be direct, hinted, told or remembered; “the game never lists the way around” is not a global interface restriction.

**Shared data does not invent behavior.** The card-gating section correctly says a new interaction needs a handler. Later claims that every new outcome is data-only, integration worlds differ only by dials or all loop worlds share pruning are hypotheses, not proof of universal coverage. Shared [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) and local mechanisms determine actual seams. “Override means higher tier wins” and S0–S7 higher scope automatically governing lower scope conflict with the document's own earlier collision correction: scope, access, targets and declared local precedence decide. A personal power can resist a larger system. Cosmic police, customs, fixed points, hostility, sanctions and variant identity confusion require an actor/information route, not automatic balance enforcement. Cosmological reach, power magnitude, permissions and institution rank are separate axes.

The V0–V6 seed-plus-diff variant sketch remains a proposal. Deterministic regeneration needs the actual source definition/revision/draw inputs and persistent deltas, not a seed alone; it must preserve custody, unique settlements, relations and historical citations. Storage compaction, inaccessible missing content and fictional branch destruction are different operations. Tombstones do not alone prove recoverability or authorize deleting worlds/saves. This reconciliation does not implement variants, prune state, acquire/extract sources, activate race bonuses, launch old lanes or exercise tests/build/browser/persistence. Keep original examples/history and continue actual reading at3,281 before a complete north-star disposition.
